about: The Wrath Unleashed guide: one source for the site's notes page (docs/leyline/wrath-unleashed.md) and the in-game guide (WrathUnleashedUI/RealmGuideData.lua). Edit here, then run python3 tools/realm-guide/make_guide.py; stream/tests/test_realm_guide.py fails when either copy is stale. Plain words, no brand words, only what is switched on on the official realm.
title: Wrath Unleashed notes
intro: Everything that is different on Wrath Unleashed, in one place. In the game, the Leyline button on the minimap opens the same guide.

pages.name: Welcome
pages.heading: Welcome to Wrath Unleashed
lines: A Wrath realm from level 1 with the things players ask for most: faster levelling, solo-friendly dungeons, one community across both factions.
Experience is 3x. Reputation and profession skill-ups are 2x. Gold, drops and honor stay normal.
Every new character can start at level 1 or take a one-time boost to 80.
Stuck or found a bug? .stuck takes you home, .bug tells us what happened.

pages.name: Start and boost
pages.heading: Your first steps
lines: A new character picks how to begin: play from level 1 (riding and your race's mount included), or boost to 80 with your spec's gear, two professions and a start in Dalaran.
Closed the window? It comes back at your next login at level 1, and .boost opens it any time below level 10.
Death Knights are open from your first character.
Spells are learned for you as you level, and weapon and defense skills stay at their best.
commands: the start window again (below level 10, once per character)
learn every spell for your level now
stop gaining experience (.xp on to level again)

pages.name: Dungeons
pages.heading: Dungeons, solo or with friends
lines: Every dungeon and raid scales to the group you bring, even just you.
The Dungeon Finder opens at level 10 and queues you alone if you like.
Loot from everything nearby with one click.
At 80: keystone dungeons that get harder each level. Talk to the keystone master in Dalaran.
commands: which dungeons to run at your level
where to go at 80: dungeons, gear, raids, PvP

pages.name: One community
pages.heading: Both factions, one community
lines: Group, raid, chat and join guilds with players of either faction.
One auction house for both factions.
A guild needs no charter signatures, and mail with items arrives at once.
World chat can be bridged to our Discord: .discord off hides those lines for you.
commands: hide the Discord lines (.discord on brings them back)
the Leyline realms and your friends

pages.name: Duels and PvP
pages.heading: Duels and PvP
lines: The duel corner in Dalaran: health and cooldowns come back after every duel.
Level 80 duels count for a rating and weekly points, with leaderboards on the site.
The 1v1 arena: rated or for fun, queued from anywhere.
Battleground and arena queues are announced in chat, so a small realm still finds games.
commands: join the 1v1 arena (.q1v1 unrated for fun)

pages.name: Looks and collections
pages.heading: Looks, transmog and collections
lines: Transmog: the Warpweaver changes how your gear looks. Call one to you anywhere.
Collections (Shift-P) shows your mounts and pets. Appearances calls the Warpweaver.
Free faction, race and appearance changes.
commands: free faction, race and appearance changes

pages.name: Challenges
pages.heading: Hardcore and challenges
lines: One life, slow experience and more: make a new character, pick Begin at level 1, then touch the Shrine of Challenge by your start zone's graveyard.

pages.name: Fun and modes
pages.heading: Minigolf, modes and your Den
lines: Minigolf and minigames to play with friends, right in the world.
Your Den: a room of your own to build in, on your PC through the launcher. Invite a friend with one link.
The Workshop shares what players build.

pages.name: Help and settings
pages.heading: Help and settings
lines: Names over heads: yours and friendly characters' are on. Change them in Interface, Names.
Items are never lost to one click: destroying one asks you to type DELETE.
Questions or ideas? Our Discord is on the site.
commands: report a bug, with where you are
your hearthstone ready again, now and then
